summary: Iter384 CLS verification on homepage. Mobile 390x780 CLS=0.2271 (FAIL, target <0.1). Desktop 1440x900 CLS=0.2418 (FAIL, target <0.1). The iter384 fixes DID successfully eliminate the blob+particles shift (0.6272 → ~0.001) on mobile. However, a NEW dominant shift is now the primary cause: the hero <section> renders at height=0 initially and then jumps to ~1111px around t=1150ms, pushing the FOOTER down by 604px and emitting a single 0.2256 (mobile) / 0.2400 (desktop) layout-shift entry at ~925-1056ms. RecentlySoldTicker at top, EN/FR toggle, hero H1 'Discover.Bid.Win.' all render correctly; no console errors.

top_shifts.root_cause: Hero <section> grew from height=0 to height=1111px between t=758ms and t=1151ms, pushing footer out of viewport

After React hydration — hero mounted at full height

iter384_fixes_effectiveness.blobs_particles_hidden_on_mobile: EFFECTIVE — 0.6272 shift eliminated. Only tiny particle shifts (~0.0003 each) remain on desktop.
iter384_fixes_effectiveness.hero_contain_layout_paint: INSUFFICIENT — `contain: layout paint` on the hero <section> does NOT reserve space; it only prevents inner reflows from propagating. When the hero <section> itself grows from 0 → 1111px on hydration, the elements BELOW it (footer + lazy-mount reservations) shift. `min-h-[90vh]` on the section is only honored AFTER the section is rendered by React; there is a paint window where the DOM tree is present but the CSS Tailwind class hasn't applied (or the section wasn't yet mounted).

verified_functionality.en_fr_toggle: FR button visible in header (functional in UI, not clicked in this measurement run — did not want to add user input which would set hadRecentInput=true and pollute CLS data)

action_items: CRITICAL: The hero <section> in /app/frontend/src/pages/HomePage.js (line 247-250) renders at height=0 initially and jumps to ~1111px at ~1050ms, causing a single 0.22-0.24 shift that dominates CLS on both mobile and desktop. Fixes to try (in order): (1) Add an explicit inline `style={{minHeight: '90vh'}}` on the hero <section> in ADDITION to the Tailwind `min-h-[90vh]` class so the reservation applies even before Tailwind CSS classes evaluate. (2) Alternatively wrap the hero in a reservation div with fixed pixel height matching the rendered height on mobile (~1111px) and desktop. (3) Investigate whether the HomePage is code-split / lazy-loaded — if the root HomePage bundle is loaded via React.lazy, the initial paint would show 0px until the chunk arrives, which matches the t=758ms→t=1151ms jump. If yes, consider preloading the homepage chunk or providing an SSR-style skeleton with the same min-height.

The hero-height 0→1111 shift correlates exactly with the footer's 604px displacement (0.2256 = 604/780 impact fraction on mobile). Confirming the root cause is the hero mount, not any LazyMount section below.
critical_code_review_comments: The `contain: layout paint` style on the hero section is being used incorrectly for CLS mitigation — it prevents INTERNAL shifts from being reported but does not prevent the hero's OWN height change from shifting downstream siblings. To fix CLS from a growing section, you must reserve space with min-height or aspect-ratio on a stable outer wrapper.

The measured hero height (1111px) exceeds `min-h-[90vh]` (702px on mobile 780vh) — the Tailwind reservation is under-sized. Even if applied at initial paint, the hero would still grow from 702→1111 causing a residual shift.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter384 successfully killed the blob+particles CLS source (0.6272 → ~0.001 on mobile) via `hidden md:block`. Remaining CLS is a SINGLE ~0.22-0.24 entry on FOOTER at ~925-1056ms caused by the hero <section> mounting/growing from height=0 → 1111px. Root cause is likely a paint window where the hero DOM is empty before React hydration or the min-h-[90vh] class hasn't computed. Recommended next fix: put an inline `style={{minHeight: 1120}}` (px, not vh) on the hero <section> or a stable wrapper around it to reserve the actual rendered height until content arrives. Re-measure with same methodology: PerformanceObserver({type:'layout-shift', buffered:true}) via add_init_script, goto, wait 3s, scroll 400px steps 350ms pauses, sum entries where !hadRecentInput.
rca of the issue: Hero <section> element (HomePage.js line 247) has `className='relative min-h-[90vh] flex items-center overflow-hidden'` and `style={{contain: 'layout paint'}}`. Between initial paint at ~758ms and hydration at ~1151ms, the section reports height=0 (measured via periodic getBoundingClientRect). At hydration, hero jumps to 1111px, pushing the footer 604px down. This produces a layout-shift entry attributed to the footer with impact fraction ~0.77 * distance fraction ~0.29 = ~0.22 on mobile. The `contain: layout paint` only isolates INTERNAL reflows; it does not reserve outer space. Mitigation: replace or supplement `min-h-[90vh]` with an inline pixel-based min-height matching actual rendered height (~1120px mobile, ~800-900px desktop), OR reserve a fixed-height skeleton wrapper around the hero and around the entire HomePage that persists until content mounts.
